subject.title: Suppress failed tool progress in Discord

question: Should this Discord message-delivery change require retained after-fix Discord transcript/recording/log proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the current source-level tests plus unretained canary observation?
rationale: The code change is focused and likely correct, but it suppresses channel-visible progress and the available live evidence does not show retained after-fix behavior or fallback warning delivery.

options.title: Require retained Discord proof
options.body: Refresh the branch and require a redacted after-fix Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs showing failed draft progress hidden while fallback warnings still deliver when expected.

options.title: Accept source-level evidence
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally land the focused source diff and tests while accepting that retained live Discord proof was not captured.

options.title: Pause until proof is practical
options.body: Keep the PR paused if neither contributor nor maintainer can capture the Discord path safely.

recommendation.title: Require retained Discord proof
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and require a redacted after-fix Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs showing failed draft progress hidden while fallback warnings still deliver when expected.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Discord and shared channel-progress history makes this the best available routing candidate for proof-sufficiency and message-delivery judgment.
